purpose: Local source index for agents working on the service catalog and future ProductDefinitions. Use these paths to inspect the actual registries, package interfaces, schemas, and Builder behavior.

local_first.rule: Use the local files listed here before consulting any remote page. Do not visit or fetch the online Gist by default; this workspace and the installed/source packages are available locally.
local_first.inspection: Read the relevant package AGENTS.md and README.md, then inspect its package manifest, exported declarations/interfaces, source, schemas, and focused tests. A package overview or GIST.md is not a substitute for the package contract.
local_first.scope: Treat each registry, installed package, and source repository as scoped evidence. Never combine handler IDs or service capability claims across registries without explicit evidence that they share a scope.
local_first.validation_claims: Do not claim Builder validation unless the actual Builder validation was run. Local interfaces support analysis but do not prove live availability or acceptance.

approval_gate.scope: Each actual service analyzed from the current catalog and handler records before its ProductDefinition is created or changed.
required_sequence: Inspect the target service in catalog.json and its ID list in catalog-handler-service-ids.json; resolve mapped IDs and independently search for relevant omitted rows in handler services.json.
Analyze the actual service using the applicable DGP/Builder contracts and the full relevant handler set.
Present the detailed analysis in chat first and save the same report under analysis/<service-slug>/ for site-owner review.
Stop and wait for the user to explicitly approve the analysis.
Only after approval, create or change the actual ProductDefinition under products/; make related catalog status changes only as approved and validate the result.
approval_gate.presentation: Chat is the primary analysis/review space. Save a readable copy in the analysis folder so the site owner can review what was done and why.
approval_gate.before_approval: Do not create or edit a ProductDefinition JSON or mark the service in_progress based on the analysis. Do not make catalog service JSON changes unless the user explicitly included them in the approved scope.
approval_gate.approval_scope: Approval applies only to the service analysis and scope presented. A different service, material source change, or materially revised mapping requires a new analysis and approval.
approval_gate.not_gated: Reading sources, preparing/presenting analysis, saving its Markdown report, and maintaining guidance or imported source snapshots requested by the user do not require this approval gate.
approval_gate.examples_rule: Use examples/ as completed/reference work only. Never treat an example ProductDefinition or example handler registry as the actual service being built.

project_sources.name: Current handler services registry
project_sources.role: User-supplied handler/service records for discovering platforms, general service categories, and service families. Preserve its scope and leave the input unchanged.
project_sources.authority: Current imported source, subject to verifying its embedded scope and snapshot context.

project_sources.name: Service roadmap catalog
project_sources.role: Roadmap organized by platform, general category, and customer-facing service, with build status per service.
project_sources.authority: Project planning artifact; it does not assert that services are live or that ProductDefinitions exist.
project_sources.constraint: This is a roadmap. Inspect the current per-service status; update a status only within the user's approved scope.

project_sources.name: Catalog service-to-handler ID map
project_sources.role: Lists handler row IDs associated with catalog service keys. It is a lookup map, not a record source or proof of complete/current coverage.
project_sources.authority: Cross-check all mapped IDs against handler services.json, identify stale IDs, and search for relevant current rows omitted from each list before mapping a ProductDefinition.

project_sources.name: Per-service analysis archive
project_sources.role: Readable per-service analysis reports discussed in chat and saved for site-owner review before ProductDefinition work.

project_sources.name: Actual ProductDefinitions
project_sources.role: Canonical JSON definitions for actual services. Inspect the current state; do not populate from examples.
project_sources.constraint: Create or edit a service only after its analysis is explicitly approved.

project_sources.name: Service Builder capability and template snapshot
project_sources.role: User-provided authoritative snapshot of registered Service Builder input capabilities, one field template, and publication-policy context.
project_sources.authority: Use for the Builder state represented by the paste. The Builder version is unspecified, so recheck the open Builder when a later task depends on current state.
project_sources.constraint: Publication policies are context only and must not be changed or generated.

project_sources.name: TygerBooster Service Builder normalization guide
project_sources.role: User-provided host-specific guidance for normalizing raw JAP provider services into TygerBooster ordering experiences.
project_sources.authority: Normalization context alongside the Service Builder/DGP contract; not a source of current service facts.
project_sources.constraint: Compatibility policies are discussed conceptually, but the current workspace restriction forbids changing or generating policies.

project_sources.name: JAP service types and order fields guide
project_sources.role: User-provided TygerBooster guide for required/optional/conditional JAP add-order fields by service type.
project_sources.authority: Use with each selected handler's actual payload.type and the current Builder/DGP contract; do not infer request fields from provider names.

project_sources.name: Project workflow and rules
project_sources.role: Step-by-step analysis, data model, validation, and agent source-index guidance.

dgp_packages.name: @elqora/dgp-sdk
dgp_packages.role: PHP domain/backend SDK; consult its handler-service and capability definitions when reasoning about handler records and runtime concepts.

dgp_packages.name: @elqora/dgp-spec
dgp_packages.role: Installed local canonical ProductDefinition contracts, type declarations, schemas, and fixtures consumed by Service Builder.
dgp_packages.authority: Use the exact locally installed version for this consumer context; check package metadata and declarations before defining fields.

dgp_packages.name: @elqora/dgp-core
dgp_packages.role: Framework-neutral ProductDefinition interpretation and product model behavior.

dgp_packages.name: @elqora/dgp-validation
dgp_packages.role: Structural and semantic publication validation rules. Inspect source and exports for supported checks; do not imply these checks were run merely because the package is present.

dgp_packages.name: @elqora/dgp-ordering
dgp_packages.role: Installed local ordering/runtime contract and behavior relevant to order inputs and submission.

dgp_packages.name: @elqora/dgp-workspace
dgp_packages.role: Headless editorial sessions and backend workspace orchestration; use when investigating editing/session workflows.

dgp_packages.name: @elqora/dgp-studio
dgp_packages.role: Visual DGP authoring, preview, diagnostics, and publication integration. Consult only for Studio-specific behavior.

dgp_packages.name: @elqora/dgp-ordering-form-palette
dgp_packages.role: Optional React ordering form palette integration; use for supported form controls and palette behavior.

consumers_and_related_sources.name: Service Builder
consumers_and_related_sources.role: Local consumer application; inspect its actual integration and runtime behavior when a definition is intended for this Builder.
consumers_and_related_sources.rule: The local GIST.md may help navigate the project, but inspect the local code and installed interfaces directly. Do not follow any online Gist URL by default.

consumers_and_related_sources.name: DGP services provider SDK
consumers_and_related_sources.role: Related provider-driver SDK and provider plugin contracts. Keep it distinct from the canonical DGP ProductDefinition spec and from the active handler registry.
consumers_and_related_sources.authority: Provider-driver implementation details only, unless the active site registry explicitly links a record to this SDK.

agent_starting_rule: For catalog analysis, begin with the project handler services JSON and the workflow. For a future ProductDefinition, inspect the applicable local dgp-spec contract, dgp-core, validation package, target Builder source, and scoped handler registry. Follow concern-specific ownership in each package's AGENTS.md.
